candidates.sentence: Continuing to build the wall along our southern border will aid in the enforcement of the law and will send a message that America is serious about the immigration problem.
In Washington, John is – and will continue to be – a reliable voice and vote for the protection of 2nd Amendment rights.
He supports the life of the unborn and always will.
John will continue to work to defund Planned Parenthood.
Additionally, he will support the work of our local women’s service providers as they help women without performing or encouraging abortions.
John supports and will vote for a fair and simple tax code that promotes economic growth and makes filing taxes easier on all Americans.
John is working against the Democrats’ efforts to implement socialized medicine, which is why he supports repealing Obamacare.
He continues to support a total repeal of Obamacare and all efforts to implement socialized medicine.
In order to achieve this, John knows we must continue to cut taxes and limit unnecessary regulations.
John supports welfare reform that provides support to those who need it most and won’t send our country further into debt.
